name: Duchess
notes: Refined, loving mother of three kittens

name: Thomas O'Malley
notes: Street-smart alley cat, protective and charming

name: Marie
notes: Eldest kitten, prim and proper, aspiring lady

name: Toulouse
notes: Middle kitten, aspiring artist, bold and scrappy

name: Berlioz
notes: Youngest kitten, musical, shy but playful

name: Edgar Balthazar
notes: Greedy butler who schemes to inherit Madame's fortune by abandoning the cats

name: Madame Adelaide Bonfamille
notes: Wealthy, kind owner of Duchess and the kittens; leaves her fortune to the cats

name: Roquefort
notes: Loyal, brave house mouse and friend of the cats

name: Scat Cat
notes: Leader of the jazz alley cat band, O'Malley's old friend

name: Napoleon
notes: Country dog, self-appointed guard; causes trouble for Edgar unintentionally

name: Frou-Frou
notes: Madame's horse, helps Roquefort and is sympathetic to the cats

name: Georges Hautecourt
notes: Madame's elderly lawyer who draws up the will leaving everything to the cats
